'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant crisis]]
****[[Ukraine]]'s [[Energoatom]] says that [[Russian Ground Forces|Russian soldiers]] have abducted two senior staff members from the [[Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant]]. Energoatom says that the two workers were "beaten" before being driven off in an "unknown direction". [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-atomic-agency-says-russian-forces-abducted-two-nuclear-plant-staff-2022-12-09/ (Reuters)]
***[[Battle of Bakhmut]]
****[[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] accuses [[Russia]] of "destroying" the [[front line]] city of [[Bakhmut]] after weeks of relentless shelling by Russian forces. [https://www.newsweek.com/russia-has-destroyed-bakhmut-donbas-front-lines-difficult-zelensky-1766091 (Newsweek)]
*[[2022 North Kosovo crisis]]
**[[Prime Minister of Serbia|Serbian Prime Minister]] [[Ana Brnabić]] says that [[Serbia]] is close to deploying its [[Serbian Armed Forces|troops]] to [[North Kosovo]] after claiming that the lives of the [[Kosovo Serbs|Serb minority]] there are "being threatened", and that the [[NATO]]-led [[Kosovo Force]] was "failing to protect them". [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/International/wireStory/officer-injured-shooting-amid-tension-northern-kosovo-94846476 (ABC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Ten people are killed and four others are injured in an explosion at a coal mine in [[Sawahlunto]], [[West Sumatra]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-c27006cfa8213992600a18a6701059f0 (AP)]
*At least one person is killed after a large explosion occurs during a massive fire at a [[shopping center]] in [[Moscow]], [[Russia]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/12/9/huge-blaze-rages-through-shopping-mall-in-russian (Al Jazeera)]

'''International relations'''
*[[United States sanctions]]
**[[China–United States relations]]
***[[United States sanctions against China]]
****The United States [[Office of Foreign Assets Control]] imposes sanctions on former [[Chinese Communist Party Committee Secretary|Chinese Communist Party Secretary]] of the [[Tibet Autonomous Region]] [[Wu Yingjie]] and [[People's Police (China)|People's Police]] chief for the [[Himalayas]] Zhang Hongbo over "serious" [[Human rights in Tibet|human rights abuses]] in [[Tibet]]. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/us-sanctions-2-chinese-officials-over-tibet-human-rights-violations-3594201 (AFP via NDTV)]
**[[Guinea–United States relations]]
***The U.S. Office of Foreign Assets Control imposes sanctions on former [[President of Guinea|Guinean president]] [[Alpha Condé]] for engaging in [[political violence]] during his presidency. [https://www.voaafrica.com/a/us-sanctions-guinea-ex-leader-conde/6869523.html (AFP via VOA)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Protests against the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**A court in Moscow sentences prominent opposition figure [[Ilya Yashin]] to eight and a half years in prison on charges related to his criticism of the [[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine|ongoing war in Ukraine]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/russian-man-jailed-8-12-years-ukraine-action-94853266 (ABC News)]
*[[Qatar corruption scandal at the European Parliament]]
**The [[Federal Police (Belgium)|Belgian Federal Police]] arrest [[Greece|Greek]] [[Member of the European Parliament|MEP]] and [[Vice-President of the European Parliament|European Parliament vice-president]] [[Eva Kaili]] following an investigation into corruption tied to lobbying efforts in support of [[Qatar]]. Kaili's [[political parties]], the [[Panhellenic Socialist Movement]] and the [[Progressive Alliance of Socialists and Democrats]], have both suspended her membership. [https://www.wionews.com/world/police-arrest-european-parliament-vice-president-eva-kaili-541727 (AFP via WION)] [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/12/09/europe/eva-kaili-european-parliament-greece-expelled-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
*Fifteen people are killed during a gunfight between [[Royal Thai Army|soldiers]] and drug smugglers in [[Mon Pin]], [[Thailand]]. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/2456279/15-dead-after-gunfight-with-drug-smugglers-near-border (Bangkok Post)]

'''Science and technology'''
*A [[Japan]]ese research team from [[Yamagata University]] announces the discovery of 168 new big figures near the [[Nazca Lines]] in [[Peru]]. [https://www.elmundo.es/ciencia-y-salud/ciencia/2022/12/09/6392ddb5fdddff635e8b4571.html (EFE via ''El Mundo'')]

'''Sports'''

**The Ironman Triathlon cancels the 2023 and 2024 triathlons to be held in [[Juneau, Alaska]], United States, citing economic concerns. [https://www.juneauempire.com/news/ironman-alaska-canceled/ (''Juneau Empire'')]
